title: Aniloops, Travel, Repair, Downtime, Transition & Spacewalk Loops
objective: Define original reusable MAL-local Aniloop compositions for travel, repair, downtime, transition and EVA/spacewalk contexts over frozen MAL-01..05 semantics without creating parallel canonical Travel, Character/NPC, World/Scene, Action/Event, Project/progression, Inventory/Asset, Combat, reward or Permission truth.

rules: MAL-06 composes frozen MAL-02 timing/input/session semantics, MAL-03 traversal projections, MAL-04 interaction/objective projections and MAL-05 behavior/state-machine projections. It does not introduce replacement primitives or owner-domain mechanics.

Aniloop definitions are authored, ordered and deterministic. The same definition, MAL-local state, logical tick and authorized owner references produce the same next step, phase, outcome and deterministic receipt.

Travel-local loops may sequence traversal, interaction, timing and objective steps but never move canonical Characters/NPCs, mutate World/Scene or Travel truth, consume fuel/resources, or commit arrival/departure.

Repair-local loops may sequence interaction, objective and timing steps but never consume Inventory/Asset truth, change canonical asset condition, commit Project progress, spend currency/resources, or grant rewards.

Downtime-local loops may sequence timing, interaction and objective steps but never advance canonical campaign/world time, heal damage, restore conditions/resources, train, craft, progress Projects or grant advancement/rewards.

Transition-local loops may sequence traversal and interaction steps to a MAL-local transition-ready/completed state but never change canonical scenes, locations, travel legs, Events or campaign state.

Spacewalk-local loops may compose traversal, hazard, interaction and behavior projections but never apply canonical damage/conditions, consume oxygen/fuel, change equipment/Inventory, move canonical Characters, or mutate World/Scene/Combat truth.

Unknown, hidden or unauthorized owner-domain state remains unresolved. Owner-reference gates cannot infer hidden availability, safety, destination, repair state, resources, objectives or NPC knowledge.
Pause, retry and accessibility-equivalent controls remain governed by MAL-02. Pausing an Aniloop freezes MAL logical progress and never advances canonical time.

AI may propose Aniloop definitions and compositions but cannot invent hidden owner state, choose secret outcomes, commit canonical travel/repair/downtime/transition/spacewalk consequences or bypass Permission/visibility.
forbidden: copied proprietary game/ROM loop logic, travel scripts, repair recipes, downtime tables, transition scripts, spacewalk sequences, maps or data
parallel canonical Travel, Character/NPC, World/Scene, Action/Event, Project/progression, Inventory/Asset, Combat, reward or Permission truth
canonical travel movement, arrival/departure, route, fuel or resource mutation
canonical repair/asset-condition, Inventory consumption, Project progress, currency/resource spend or reward mutation
canonical downtime healing, condition/resource restoration, training, crafting, campaign/world time, advancement or reward mutation
canonical spacewalk damage, oxygen/fuel, equipment, movement, World/Scene or Combat mutation
hidden-data reveal or unauthorized owner-state inference

minimum_cross_domain_authority: MAL-05 frozen NPC/enemy behavior/tiny state-machine contract
invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one MAL-06 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
